name: AgenticSeek
description: Local-first assistant that browses the web, writes and runs code and plans multi-step tasks on your own hardware.
whatItDoes: Searches and reads websites, fills forms, writes and debugs programs in several languages and breaks larger jobs into steps. Meant for users who want a private assistant running on local models.
howItWorks: A router picks the best specialised agent for each request and a planner coordinates several agents for complex tasks. Docker runs bundled services such as SearxNG, and a config.ini file selects the local or remote model provider.

requirements.name: Docker Engine and Docker Compose
requirements.description: Runs bundled services such as SearxNG

requirements.name: GPU for local models
requirements.description: Needed to run roughly 14B reasoning models locally; an API provider can be used instead

models: Ollama, LM Studio and other local providers, or OpenAI-style APIs
